content_text:
If you pick the “correct” exposure for the mood you want, then in theory you wouldn’t be pushing it around in post.
That’s
the issue, do you want to expose for the look you want… or do you want maximum flexibility to push it around in post, i.e. change your mind?
It’s possible to split the difference, i.e. play it safer by working at a base ISO with fairly minimal noise so you have
some
room to adjust without noise becoming too problematic even while exposing for the look you want.
